articles.title: Comptroller says only Democrats pressuring over crypto trust charter
articles.snippet: US Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould and New York Representative Gregory Meeks sparred over Donald Trump’s influence on regulators he has nominated as president at a Thursday oversight hearing.

articles.title: Bitcoin Has Dumped All of Its Gains Since Trump Was Reelected—And Then Some
articles.snippet: Bitcoin surged in the wake of President Trump's reelection, pushing to new highs deep into 2025. Now it's down more than 50% from that peak.

articles.title: US Bitcoin Reserve Moving Ahead at ‘Deliberate Speed’: Bessent
articles.snippet: The Treasury chief told senators the administration is using “best practices” in implementing Trump's Bitcoin reserve order.
